input.quote: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party. Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement,
input.rationale: Paragraph 4(a) is the only convenience-termination mechanic in the Agreement and it fails the fallback in two material respects: AP has no no-cause exit during the Initial Term (the lock-in is mutual and the 90-day right operates only "following the Initial Term"), and Kubient's post-Initial Term right is untethered to term-end, so Kubient can walk away mid-renewal-term (an auto-renewal/notice right is not term-end-only unless the effective date is expressly anchored to the end of the then-current term). Our single edit confines the Initial Term lock-in to Kubient and splits the mutual sentence so that AP has an express right to terminate for convenience on 90 days' written notice to Kubient with no timing restriction, while Kubient's no-cause right expressly requires 90 days' written notice to AP and takes effect only at the end of the then-current Term. The retained fee sentence entitles Kubient only to fees generated during the termination period, i.e. revenue earned through the 90-day notice window, so no early-termination fee exceeding three months' fees exists. We do not pursue the preferred level (30 days' notice and pro-rata refund of prepaid fees), which is a poor fit for this revenue-share structure with no prepaid fees; the redline lands at the fallback.

proposal.summary: State AP's express 90-day convenience right and confine Kubient's 90-day no-cause termination to the end of the then-current Term.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have limited the Initial Term lock-in to Kubient and split the mutual exit into an express AP right to terminate for convenience on 90 days' written notice to Kubient, and a Kubient right on 90 days' written notice to AP that takes effect only at the end of the then-current Term. This is our fallback position; the fee entitlement and the breach and insolvency rights are unchanged.

ops.oldText: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Kubient may not terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon ninety (90) days written notice to Kubient, and Kubient may terminate this Agreement for any reason upon ninety (90) days written notice to Customer, effective only at the end of the then-current Term.
